title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease and blood pressure management.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding ESRD and hypertension. He reports feeling stable overall, noting no significant new symptoms since the last visit. He continues to manage his blood pressure daily and reports adherence to his current medication regimen. He denies any shortness of breath, significant edema, or recent changes in his physical functional status.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily, and Furosemide 40mg daily.

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 138/82 mmHg. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema is noted in the lower extremities.

Assessment
1. ESRD
2. Hypertension

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and chronic kidney disease. Patient instructed to monitor home blood pressure and report any significant fluctuations. Follow-up in 3 months for laboratory monitoring and blood pressure check.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
